# Ruby Gillis

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P1](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0001)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_

## Appearance

Ruby Gillis possesses real showy looks, characterized by a plump and striking figure. She has large, bright-blue eyes, a brilliant complexion, and wears her hair in a long yellow braid.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P43](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0043), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P1](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0001)_

## Personality

Ruby Gillis is a cheerful and good-tempered individual who frankly enjoys the pleasant things in life, though she is inclined to succumb to hysterics. Obsessed with young men, her primary motivations revolve around romance: she intends to have a beau by the age of fifteen, aims to have numerous suitors infatuated with her when she grows up, and plans to teach for only two years before getting married.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P39](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0039), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. ## History

Ruby Gillis grew up with many older sisters and possessed a reputation for successfully charming away all her warts using a magic pebble. As a schoolgirl in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), she gave a warm welcome to [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) upon Anne's return to school. She later joined a story club formed by [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), alongside [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) and [Jane](../character/jane.md), engaging in creative writing activities with moral aims. Ruby eventually joined Miss Stacy's advanced preparation class for the Queen's [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) examination, pursuing her higher education ambitions before attending Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy) alongside her classmates.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P1](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XV. ## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--ruby-gillis.md)

Ruby Gillis is a friend and schoolmate of [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) who exchanges gifts and tokens of appreciation with her. They spend time together with their group of peers, such as gathering Mayflowers during spring adventures and attending school social gatherings. Ruby and the other schoolmates also visit and keep track of [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) while she recovers from a fractured ankle after taking a dare.

- Friend of — schoolmates who exchange gifts and tokens of appreciation  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P13](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0013), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P20](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0020)</sub>
